title: World Cup Card Game
author: rodrodrod89
selftext:
Hey guys, i'm deploying my first game this week. Ton of work still on going, new game modes. If you could give me some feedbacks I'll apreciate!  
  
[https://futegic.com/](https://futegic.com/)  
  
Love from Brazil  
Thanks

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Right now this post breaks rule 1. Can you explain how you used AI in the development?

replies.author: rodrodrod89
replies.body:
I'm sorry, I thought that if i made the game using AI was acceptable.

I made the entire game using Claude Code for coding and the visual assets with Gemini and others models. It's ok or should I provide more details?

replies.author: fisj
replies.body: It is, but if you dont at least state it for the development community here, then we have no way to know. Its not a super high bar.

replies.author: rodrodrod89
replies.body: Ah ok no problem, I'm really beginner in this area. Just looking for some feedback to improve and if someone had fun with the game, mission accomplished 😄

comments.author: captain_proton
comments.body:
Is there any way to work out what player the CPU might choose and select your own player in a tactical way? Or is it just pure luck? I found myself always just picking whoever had the highest ratings.

I don't mind games in this area but a layer of tactics and some semblance that Im playing somethting football related would elevate it.

The card designs are clean and the shirt art is good!

I'm actually working on a football-themed card game, a deckbuilder. Would you be interested in trying it out at some point?
